mapper.select: SELECT s.stock_name AS "name", s.stock_code AS "code", s.active AS "active", a.quantity AS "shares", a.purchase_amount AS "buyPrice", a.avg_price AS "avgBuyPrice" FROM asset a JOIN stock s ON a.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT s.stock_name AS "name", r.sell_quantity AS "shares", r.avg_price AS "buyPrice", (r.sell_amount / r.sell_quantity) AS "sellPrice", r.realized_profit AS "profit", (r.realized_profit / r.cost_basis) * 100 AS "profitRate", r.sell_date AS "tradeDate" FROM realized_pnl r JOIN stock s ON r.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE r.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.sell_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND r.sell_date < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY r.sell_date DESC

SELECT s.stock_name AS "stockName", s.stock_code AS "stockCode", o.quantity AS "orderQty", o.order_price AS "orderPrice", o.transaction_type AS "type", (o.quantity * o.order_price) AS "orderAmount", DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "orderTime", /* 개별 체결 수량 */ COALESCE(tl.trade_quantity, 0) AS "executedQty", /* 누적 체결 수량 (윈도우 함수 사용) */ (o.quantity - COALESCE( SUM(tl.trade_quantity) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.order_id ORDER BY tl.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ), 0) ) AS "unexecutedQty", ((o.quantity - COALESCE( SUM(tl.trade_quantity) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.order_id ORDER BY tl.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ), 0) ) * o.order_price) AS "unexecutedAmount", tl.trade_price AS "executedPrice", DATE_FORMAT(tl.trade_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "executedTime", o.status AS "status" FROM stock_order o JOIN stock s ON o.stock_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN trade_log tl ON o.order_id = tl.order_id WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.created_at >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (o.status <> 'CANCEL' OR tl.trade_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY COALESCE(tl.trade_date, o.updated_at) DESC

SELECT m.nickname AS "nickname", a.account_number AS "accountNumber", a.balance AS "balance", a.account_created_at AS "createdAt" FROM account a JOIN member m ON a.user_id = m.user_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}
